items.title: India introduces windfall tax on petrol and diesel exports
items.text: India announced a windfall tax effective 16 October 2026 of ₹2.50 per litre on petrol exports and ₹8.50 per litre on diesel exports.

items.title: India's September unemployment rate reported at 5%
items.text: Current-affairs reports citing the National Statistics Office say India's overall unemployment rate was 5% in September 2026.

items.title: India's Ramsar site tally reaches 103
items.text: The addition of Sukhna Wetland in Chandigarh and Sauj Jheel in Uttar Pradesh takes India's Ramsar wetland site count to 103, according to the daily current-affairs briefing.

items.title: Caller name display service planned from 1 November
items.text: The Department of Telecommunications has directed telecom providers to introduce Calling Name Presentation (CNAP), which displays a registered caller name, from 1 November 2026.

items.title: Indian wrestler Vishvajit More wins silver at U-23 World Championships
items.text: Indian wrestler Vishvajit Ramchandra More won silver in the men's 55 kg Greco-Roman event at the U-23 World Championships in Las Vegas on 15 October.
